description: This file defines a Java interface for custom assertions related to Jsonifiable objects with predicates, used for testing or validation purposes within the project.

classes.name: JsonifiableWithPredicateAssert
classes.description: A generic interface providing assertion methods for objects implementing Jsonifiable with predicates, specifically for comparing JSON objects based on a predicate.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Asserts that the fields matched by the provided predicate are the same for both the actual and expected Jsonifiable objects.
